avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer significantly reduces fosamprenavir concentrations by 40-50%, compromising antiretroviral efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Absolute contraindication—do not use concurrently; consider alternatives if mood support needed

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin/Rifabutin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducers dramatically decrease fosamprenavir levels below therapeutic range
avoid_supplements.action: Do not combine; if TB treatment necessary, switch to alternative antiretroviral regimen

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic supplements (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce fosamprenavir concentrations and viral suppression effectiveness
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose garlic supplements; culinary amounts are acceptable

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 induction may slightly reduce fosamprenavir levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor viral load; use only if clearly beneficial and with prescriber awareness

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild CYP3A4 interaction with variable clinical significance
caution_supplements.action: Limit use and inform prescriber; monitor for loss of viral control

caution_supplements.name: Calcium/Iron supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce fosamprenavir absorption if taken simultaneously
caution_supplements.action: Separate dosing by ≥2 hours; take minerals at different times

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals with fosamprenavir (unboosted)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Food effect increases fosamprenavir absorption unpredictably; dosing consistency compromised
avoid_foods.action: When used without ritonavir, take on empty stomach; if ritonavir-boosted, take with food for optimal absorption

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase fosamprenavir concentrations slightly; effect modest with protease inhibitors
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; monitor for increased adverse effects (GI, hepatic symptoms)

caution_foods.name: Pomegranate juice
caution_foods.mechanism: Minor CYP3A4 inhibition with uncertain clinical relevance for fosamprenavir
caution_foods.action: Use occasionally with awareness; not typically restrictive

monitoring_notes: Fosamprenavir is typically boosted with ritonavir, which dominates CYP3A4 interaction profile; monitor viral load and CD4 counts regularly, especially if supplements are added. Assess for signs of inadequate viral suppression (elevated viral RNA, declining CD4) or excess drug exposure (elevated liver enzymes, GI disturbance).
